note: Realistic sample of feedback left by Experience.com business customers (loan officers, agents, branch managers, team admins) across in-app NPS surveys, support tickets and public review replies. Used to demonstrate the Feedback Insights panel end to end.

responses.text: Great support from the team! They resolved my issue quickly and were very friendly.
Response time was really fast. Had my review request template fixed within the hour.
Pricing options are confusing. I'm not sure which plan is right for me or what happens if I add another agent mid-cycle.
The support agent walked me through bulk uploading our whole branch roster. Excellent service.
Checkout process was not clear. Kept getting errors when trying to pay and had to call in to finish upgrading.
Really fast response time. Impressed with how quickly review requests go out after closing.
Staff are friendly and genuinely helpful whenever I email in.
Everything was good but I didn't understand the pricing options. The plan comparison page raised more questions than it answered.
Tried to add seats for two new loan officers and the checkout page just spun. Ended up doing it over the phone.
Very happy with the service. My Google reviews have gone up noticeably since we started.
Support was excellent but checkout was confusing when I upgraded my plan.
Quick turnaround on my ticket. Friendly team, no complaints there.
Love how fast the survey invites go out. Clients respond the same day.
I still can't tell what's included in Pro versus Premier. The pricing page needs a proper comparison table.
The onboarding call was great. Our rep was patient and knew the product inside out.
Profile page looks sharp and my reviews sync through to it fast.
Payment failed three times at checkout with no useful error message. Nearly cancelled over it.
Support team is the best part of the product. Always fast, always friendly.
Good product overall, but the subscription billing date changed after I upgraded and nobody explained why.
Fast service every time we raise something. Rarely waiting more than an hour.
Friendly staff, easy to deal with. The dashboard is clear once you learn it.
Confusing pricing. We were quoted per-seat then billed on a bundle. Took two emails to sort out.
Really responsive support. Got a same-day answer on my listing sync question.
Great experience overall. Review volume is up and the team is helpful.
Checkout errored out on card entry twice. The retry cleared my cart and I had to reselect the plan.
Support is quick and friendly. Only wish the pricing was easier to follow.
Fast, friendly and knowledgeable. Genuinely good service.
Product is solid. Pricing tiers are hard to compare without calling sales.
Survey response rates are the best we've had. Support helped tune the send timing.
The upgrade checkout doesn't show tax until the final step, which caught our finance team off guard.
Very friendly staff. They followed up to make sure everything was working.
Fast service. Tickets get picked up much quicker than our last vendor.
I don't understand what I'm paying for. The invoice line items don't match the plan names on the pricing page.
Support sorted my SSO issue in minutes. Excellent.
Great staff, quick answers, and the reporting is genuinely useful for our monthly review.
Happy overall. Fast responses and the profile page converts well.
Checkout is broken on Safari. Card field wouldn't accept input at all until I switched browser.
Support has been consistently excellent. Friendly and fast.
Decent, though I was surprised by the annual commitment at checkout. Not obvious on the plan page.
Fast service, friendly people. Onboarding our second branch was painless.
Good tool. Support answers quickly whenever I get stuck.
Pricing confusion again — we added a seat and the prorated charge wasn't explained anywhere before we confirmed.
Really friendly support team. They actually follow through.
Fast and reliable. Review requests fire the moment I close a loan.
Support quality is high. Dashboard could surface trends better but that's minor.
Tried to upgrade twice, checkout failed both times with a generic error. Lost half an hour.
Excellent support. Quick, friendly, and they explained the fix clearly.
Plan pricing is not transparent enough. I'd like to see the full cost before I start checkout.
Very fast service. Same-day responses every time.
Staff friendliness stands out. Our account manager is excellent.
Checkout confusion — I couldn't tell whether I was buying monthly or annual until the receipt arrived.
Support is fast and friendly. Reporting exports work well.
Great service and the team is lovely to deal with.
Quick responses, helpful people. Happy customer.
Pricing page and checkout total didn't match. Had to raise a ticket to confirm what we'd actually be charged.
Fast service, friendly staff, and my review count keeps climbing.
Support resolved a billing question in one reply. Very impressed.
Solid platform. Friendly and responsive team behind it.
Good product but I gave up on self-serve upgrade — the checkout flow lost me and I called instead.
Excellent support and fast service. No hesitation recommending it.
